title: Llama 8B on GSM-Hard: does a weaker model show contagion where Claude doesn't?

notes: Same GSM-Hard math problems, same conditions — but Llama 3.1 8B instead of Claude Haiku 4.5.
Cost of Consensus found 85.5% conformity with 7-8B models. We found 0% with Claude.
If Llama shows contagion here, the paper is about model capability, not system design.
Compare: 1-wrong baseline vs 4-wrong majority, memory vs chat.
This is the critical cross-model test.
